content.title: US to Unveil New Tariffs on Global Trading Partners
content.caption: The US has announced a new round of tariffs on imports, targeting major trading partners like China, the EU, and Japan.

slides.heading: US to Unveil New Tariffs on Global Trading Partners
slides.text: The US has announced a new round of tariffs on imports, targeting major trading partners like China, the EU, and Japan.

slides.heading: Tariff Impact
slides.text: The new tariffs will affect many of the US's biggest trading partners, including China, the EU, and Japan.

slides.heading: Tariff Details
slides.text: The tariffs will hit China at up to 40%, Vietnam at up to 35%, and others at 20% or 25%. Some rates will be reduced due to Trump's agreements.
